passages.text: When the ark of the LORD had been in the land of the Philistines seven months, the Philistines summoned the priests and diviners, saying, “What shall we do with the ark of the LORD? Tell us how to send it back to its place.”
passages.sermon:
The ark of the LORD stayed in the land of the Philistines for seven months.
The Philistines called for their priests and their diviners.
The Philistines spoke to them.
They said, "What should we do with the ark of the LORD?"
They said, "Tell us how we should send it back to its place."
passages.original: וַיְהִ֧י אֲרוֹן־ יְהוָ֛ה בִּשְׂדֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים שִׁבְעָ֥ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃ וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים לַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים וְלַקֹּֽסְמִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַאֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה הוֹדִעֻ֕נוּ בַּמֶּ֖ה נְשַׁלְּחֶ֥נּוּ לִמְקוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They replied, “If you return the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it away empty, but by all means return it to Him with a guilt offering. Then you will be healed, and you will understand why His hand has not been lifted from you.”
passages.sermon:
The Philistines spoke to their priests and diviners.
They asked what to do with the ark of the God of Israel.
The priests and diviners answered them.
They said, "If you return the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it away empty."
They said, "You must return a guilt offering to Him."
If you do this, you will be healed.
You will also understand why God’s hand has not been lifted from you.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אִֽם־ מְשַׁלְּחִ֞ים אֶת־ אֲר֨וֹן אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אַל־ תְּשַׁלְּח֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ רֵיקָ֔ם כִּֽי־ הָשֵׁ֥ב תָּשִׁ֛יבוּ ל֖וֹ אָשָׁ֑ם אָ֤ז תֵּרָֽפְאוּ֙ וְנוֹדַ֣ע לָכֶ֔ם לָ֛מָּה לֹא־ תָס֥וּר יָד֖וֹ מִכֶּֽם׃

passages.text: “What guilt offering should we send back to Him?” asked the Philistines. “Five gold tumors and five gold rats,” they said, “according to the number of rulers of the Philistines, since the same plague has struck both you and your rulers.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines spoke.
They asked, “What guilt offering should we send to the God of Israel?”
The priests and diviners answered.
They said, “Send five gold tumors.”
They also said, “Send five gold rats.”
There are five rulers of the Philistines.
The number of gold tumors and gold rats must match the number of rulers.
The same plague struck all the Philistines.
The same plague struck all their rulers.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ מָ֣ה הָאָשָׁם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָשִׁ֣יב לוֹ֒ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ מִסְפַּר֙ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עָפְלֵי זָהָ֔ב וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה עַכְבְּרֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב כִּֽי־ מַגֵּפָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לְכֻלָּ֖ם וּלְסַרְנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Make images of your tumors and of the rats that are ravaging the land. Give glory to the God of Israel, and perhaps He will lift His hand from you and your gods and your land.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines suffered from tumors and a plague of rats.
The rats destroyed their land.
The Philistines needed to make images of their tumors.
They also needed to make images of the rats.
They had to give these images to the God of Israel.
This act would give honor to the God of Israel.
If they did this, God might show mercy.
God might remove His hand from the Philistines.
God might also stop punishing their gods.
God might also stop punishing their land.
passages.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֩ צַלְמֵ֨י עָפְלֵיכֶם וְצַלְמֵ֣י עַכְבְּרֵיכֶ֗ם הַמַּשְׁחִיתִם֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וּנְתַתֶּ֛ם לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּב֑וֹד אוּלַ֗י יָקֵ֤ל אֶת־ יָדוֹ֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וּמֵעַ֥ל אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם וּמֵעַ֥ל אַרְצְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Why harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened theirs? When He afflicted them, did they not send the people on their way as they departed?
passages.sermon:
The Philistines spoke to each other.
They asked a question.
They said, “Why do you harden your hearts?”
They spoke to the Philistines.
They warned them not to be stubborn.
They said, “Do not be stubborn like the Egyptians.”
They said, “Do not be stubborn like Pharaoh.”
The Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts.
God punished the Egyptians and Pharaoh.
God afflicted them with plagues.
After God punished them, the Egyptians let the Israelites go.
The Israelites left Egypt.
The Egyptians sent them away.
passages.original: וְלָ֤מָּה תְכַבְּדוּ֙ אֶת־ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר כִּבְּד֛וּ מִצְרַ֥יִם וּפַרְעֹ֖ה אֶת־ לִבָּ֑ם הֲלוֹא֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְעַלֵּ֣ל בָּהֶ֔ם וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֖וּם וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃

passages.text: Now, therefore, prepare one new cart with two milk cows that have never been yoked. Hitch the cows to the cart, but take their calves away and pen them up.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines had taken the ark of the LORD.
They suffered because of this.
Their leaders gave instructions.
They said, “Prepare one new cart.
Take two milk cows.
These cows have never been yoked.
Hitch the cows to the cart.
Take their calves away from them.
Pen the calves up at home.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה קְח֨וּ וַעֲשׂ֜וּ עֲגָלָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ אֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּ֤י פָרוֹת֙ עָל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ עָלָ֥ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עֹ֑ל וַאֲסַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ הַפָּרוֹת֙ בָּעֲגָלָ֔ה וַהֲשֵׁיבֹתֶ֧ם בְּנֵיהֶ֛ם מֵאַחֲרֵיהֶ֖ם הַבָּֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: Take the ark of the LORD, set it on the cart, and in a chest beside it put the gold objects you are sending Him as a guilt offering. Then send the ark on its way, but keep watching it. If it goes up the road to its homeland, toward Beth-shemesh, it is the LORD who has brought on us this great disaster. But if it does not, then we will know that it was not His hand that punished us and that it happened by chance.”
passages.sermon:
The Philistine leaders spoke to their people.
They gave clear instructions about the ark of the LORD.
Take the ark of the LORD.
Place the ark on the cart.
Take the gold objects you are sending as a guilt offering.
Put these gold objects in a chest beside the ark.
Send the cart away.
Let it go on its way.
Watch what happens next.
If the cart goes up the road to Beth-shemesh, this will show something important.
Beth-shemesh is the homeland of the ark.
If the cart goes there, the LORD has brought this great disaster on us.
If the cart does not go there, we will know something else.
We will know that the LORD did not punish us.
We will know that these troubles happened to us by chance.
passages.original: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וּנְתַתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣עֲגָלָ֔ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ כְּלֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֲשֵׁבֹתֶ֥ם לוֹ֙ אָשָׁ֔ם תָּשִׂ֥ימוּ בָאַרְגַּ֖ז מִצִּדּ֑וֹ וְשִׁלַּחְתֶּ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ וְהָלָֽךְ׃ וּרְאִיתֶ֗ם אִם־ דֶּ֨רֶךְ גְּבוּל֤וֹ יַֽעֲלֶה֙ בֵּ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ ה֚וּא עָ֣שָׂה לָ֔נוּ אֶת־ הָרָעָ֥ה הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את וְאִם־ לֹ֗א וְיָדַ֙עְנוּ֙ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָדוֹ֙ נָ֣גְעָה בָּ֔נוּ מִקְרֶ֥ה ה֖וּא הָ֥יָה לָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.
passages.sermon:
The men followed the instructions.
They took two milk cows.
They hitched the cows to the cart.
They put the calves in the house.
They kept the calves away from the cows.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֤וּ הָאֲנָשִׁים֙ כֵּ֔ן וַיִּקְח֗וּ שְׁתֵּ֤י פָרוֹת֙ עָל֔וֹת וַיַּאַסְר֖וּם בָּעֲגָלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּל֥וּ בַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: Then they put the ark of the LORD on the cart, along with the chest containing the gold rats and the images of the tumors.
passages.sermon:
The men took the ark of the LORD.
They placed the ark on the cart.
They also took a chest.
They put the chest on the cart.
The chest contained gold rats.
The chest also contained images of tumors.
passages.original: וַיָּשִׂ֛מוּ אֶת־ אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ הָעֲגָלָ֑ה וְאֵ֣ת הָאַרְגַּ֗ז וְאֵת֙ עַכְבְּרֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֵ֖ת צַלְמֵ֥י טְחֹרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And the cows headed straight up the road toward Beth-shemesh, staying on that one highway and lowing as they went, never straying to the right or to the left. The rulers of the Philistines followed behind them to the border of Beth-shemesh.
passages.sermon:
Two cows pulled a cart.
The cows walked straight on the road to Beth-shemesh.
They stayed on one path.
They did not turn to the right.
They did not turn to the left.
The cows made lowing sounds as they walked.
The rulers of the Philistines followed the cows.
The rulers followed them all the way to the border of Beth-shemesh.
passages.original: וַיִשַּׁ֨רְנָה הַפָּר֜וֹת בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ עַל־ דֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ בֵּ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ בִּמְסִלָּ֣ה אַחַ֗ת הָלְכ֤וּ הָלֹךְ֙ וְגָע֔וֹ וְלֹא־ סָ֖רוּ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֑אול וְסַרְנֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ הֹלְכִ֣ים אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם עַד־ גְּב֖וּל בֵּ֥ית שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were harvesting wheat in the valley, and when they looked up and saw the ark, they were overjoyed at the sight.
passages.sermon:
The people of Beth-shemesh were in the valley.
They were harvesting wheat.
They looked up.
They saw the ark of the LORD.
They felt great joy when they saw the ark.
passages.original: וּבֵ֣ית שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ קֹצְרִ֥ים קְצִיר־ חִטִּ֖ים בָּעֵ֑מֶק וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ אֶת־ עֵינֵיהֶ֗ם וַיִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אָר֔וֹן וַֽיִּשְׂמְח֖וּ לִרְאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The cart came to the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh and stopped there near a large rock. The people chopped up the cart and offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The cart carried the ark of the LORD.
The cart arrived at the field of Joshua.
Joshua lived in Beth-shemesh.
The cart stopped in that field.
A large rock stood in that place.
The people broke up the wood of the cart.
They took the cows from the cart.
They offered the cows as a burnt offering to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהָעֲגָלָ֡ה בָּ֠אָה אֶל־ שְׂדֵ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בֵּֽית־ הַשִּׁמְשִׁי֙ וַתַּעֲמֹ֣ד שָׁ֔ם וְשָׁ֖ם אֶ֣בֶן גְּדוֹלָ֑ה וַֽיְבַקְּעוּ֙ אֶת־ עֲצֵ֣י הָעֲגָלָ֔ה וְאֶת־ הַ֨פָּר֔וֹת הֶעֱל֥וּ עֹלָ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: And the Levites took down the ark of the LORD and the chest containing the gold objects, and they placed them on the large rock. That day the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings and made sacrifices to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served God in Israel.
The Levites took down the ark of the LORD.
The Levites also took down the chest that was with the ark.
The chest contained gold objects.
The Levites placed the ark and the chest on a large rock.
The men of Beth-shemesh lived in the town of Beth-shemesh.
That day, the men of Beth-shemesh offered burnt offerings to the LORD.
They also made sacrifices to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם הוֹרִ֣ידוּ׀ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וְאֶת־ הָאַרְגַּ֤ז אֲשֶׁר־ אִתּוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֣וֹ כְלֵֽי־ זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֖מוּ אֶל־ הָאֶ֣בֶן הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵֽית־ שֶׁ֗מֶשׁ הֶעֱל֨וּ עֹל֜וֹת וַֽיִּזְבְּח֧וּ זְבָחִ֛ים בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And when the five rulers of the Philistines saw this, they returned to Ekron that same day.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines had five rulers.
These five rulers saw what happened.
They saw the events at Beth-shemesh.
That same day, the five rulers returned to Ekron.
passages.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה סַרְנֵֽי־ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים רָא֑וּ וַיָּשֻׁ֥בוּ עֶקְר֖וֹן בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ס

passages.text: As a guilt offering to the LORD, the Philistines had sent back one gold tumor for each city: Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines sent a guilt offering to the LORD.
They sent gold objects shaped like tumors.
They sent one gold tumor for each city.
The cities were Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ טְחֹרֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵשִׁ֧יבוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֛ים אָשָׁ֖ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה לְאַשְׁדּ֨וֹד אֶחָ֜ד לְעַזָּ֤ה אֶחָד֙ לְאַשְׁקְל֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לְגַ֥ת אֶחָ֖ד לְעֶקְר֥וֹן אֶחָֽד׃ס

passages.text: The number of gold rats also corresponded to the number of Philistine cities belonging to the five rulers—the fortified cities and their outlying villages. And the large rock on which they placed the ark of the LORD stands to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
passages.sermon:
The Philistines had five rulers.
Each ruler controlled several cities.
The Philistines sent gold rats as a guilt offering to the LORD.
They sent one gold rat for each Philistine city.
This included both fortified cities and their outlying villages.
The number of gold rats matched the total number of these cities and villages.
The Philistines placed the ark of the LORD on a large rock.
This rock still stands today.
It is in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.
passages.original: וְעַכְבְּרֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֗ב מִסְפַּ֞ר כָּל־ עָרֵ֤י פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ לַחֲמֵ֣שֶׁת הַסְּרָנִ֔ים מֵעִ֣יר מִבְצָ֔ר וְעַ֖ד כֹּ֣פֶר הַפְּרָזִ֑י וְעַ֣ד׀ אָבֵ֣ל הַגְּדוֹלָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִנִּ֤יחוּ עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה עַ֚ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בִּשְׂדֵ֥ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בֵּֽית־ הַשִּׁמְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: But God struck down some of the people of Beth-shemesh because they looked inside the ark of the LORD. He struck down seventy men, and the people mourned because the LORD had struck them with a great slaughter.
passages.sermon:
God is holy.
God punished the people of Beth-shemesh.
The people of Beth-shemesh looked inside the ark of the LORD.
God struck down seventy men from Beth-shemesh.
The LORD caused a great slaughter among the people.
The people mourned because many died.
passages.original: וַיַּ֞ךְ בְּאַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵֽית־ שֶׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֤י רָאוּ֙ בַּאֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּ֤ךְ בָּעָם֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֑ישׁ וַיִּֽתְאַבְּל֣וּ הָעָ֔ם כִּֽי־ הִכָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בָּעָ֖ם מַכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה

passages.text: The men of Beth-shemesh asked, “Who can stand in the presence of the LORD, this holy God? To whom should the ark go up from here?”
passages.sermon:
The men of Beth-shemesh spoke.
They had seen God strike down many people.
They saw that the LORD is holy.
They asked a question.
They said, "Who can stand before the LORD?"
They called the LORD the holy God.
They asked, "To whom will the ark go from us?"
They wanted to know who could receive the ark.
passages.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י בֵֽית־ שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ מִ֚י יוּכַ֣ל לַעֲמֹ֔ד לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים הַקָּד֖וֹשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְאֶל־ מִ֖י יַעֲלֶ֥ה מֵעָלֵֽינוּ׃ס

passages.text: So they sent messengers to the people of Kiriath-jearim, saying, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD. Come down and take it up with you.”
passages.sermon:
The people of Beth-shemesh sent messengers.
They sent the messengers to the people living in Kiriath-jearim.
The messengers spoke to the people of Kiriath-jearim.
They said, “The Philistines have returned the ark of the LORD.
Come down.
Take the ark of the LORD up with you.”
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י קִרְיַת־ יְעָרִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵשִׁ֤בוּ פְלִשְׁתִּים֙ אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה רְד֕וּ הַעֲל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
